outcome: mRNA expression (muscarinic receptors, histamine receptors, bradykinin receptor 2, eNOS)
cohort: This study collected placental, umbilical, cerebral, and mesenteric vessels from humans (normal and preeclamptic), sheep, and rats for experimental analysis.
finding: Receptor-mediated endothelium-dependent dilation in placental circulation was significantly weaker than in other vessels, and exogenous NO regulates placental circulation baseline tone via sGC, with lower NO production and decreased NO/sGC potentially contributing to preeclampsia.
